'''Lacunas Subartuk''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] some time before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A long [[Time/Legends|time]] after his [[Death/Legends|death]], Subartuk was considered one of the most vigilant [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the ancient order. [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and other Jedi visited the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and built their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] to resemble [[Lacunas Subartuk's lightsaber|Subartuk's]]. Later, in the [[New Jedi Order]] founded by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] design would inspire the [[Sentinel (hilt)|Sentinel]] lightsaber.
